name: Finland: check of forms and supplied documents

common.check: Trial title and EU trial number (if assigned) match the protocol and CTIS.
Every field the assistant answers is answered; fields that belong to the site, investigator, insurer or sponsor finance are left empty, not invented.
Language matches requirements.json: K1 and the consent procedure in Finnish and/or Swedish; other administrative documents in Finnish, Swedish or English.
No signature for submission (Tukija: signatures not required on dossier documents at CTIS submission); file is PDF or PDF/A.
CTIS title follows the naming guide and requirements.json.

FI-K1.check: Uses the EU Recruitment and Informed Consent Procedure template v2.0 (new Part II submissions from 1 September 2026).
The inclusion procedure is described and the first act of recruitment is clearly identified.

The Yes/No answers for incapacitated adults, minors, impartial witness and emergency match the project's populations and study facts; each Yes section is completed, each No section says not applicable.
Finland-specific parts (national_fields v105, v108, v110, v114, v117, v121) are completed in Finnish and/or Swedish.
Recruitment routes, response handling and informing people found unsuitable match the recruitment material (K2) and the protocol.
The age-15 independent pathway, the assessment of understanding and the guardian notification are described.
Interpreter arrangements throughout the trial are described.

FI-L1-PROCEDURE.check: Identical to the final FI-K1 file (same version and language).
Covers how information is provided, who conducts the prior interview, how understanding is confirmed, decision time and how consent is documented, for every relevant pathway.
Uploaded under Subject information and informed consent procedure with its own CTIS title.

FI-N-SITES.check: CTIS lists every planned Finnish site with the principal investigator's name and position and the planned participant number, matching the M and N documents.
Any supporting document is in English, Finnish or Swedish and has no participant-facing content in English.

FI-M1.check: One current CV per principal investigator and site, on the EU template.
Shows professional and scientific qualifications, relevant patient-care and clinical-trial experience, and GCP training.
Only trial fields were filled by the assistant.

FI-M2-DOI.check: One declaration per principal investigator and site, on the EU template; economic interests, institutional affiliations and other conditions are answered by the investigator.

FI-N1.check: Covers facilities, equipment, staff and expertise specific to this protocol and IMP for each site.
If one document covers all sites, the sites are clearly separated.
Made by the site or a sponsor contact person or other sponsor representative; no signature in the CTIS copy.

FI-O1.check: Describes insurance or another appropriate guarantee covering sponsor and investigator liability for participant injury, filed under Proof of insurance cover or indemnification.
The participant documents describe the same arrangement (Pharmaceutical Injuries Insurance vs site patient insurance, or the amended alternative).

FI-P2.check: States the sponsor, conflicts or commitments linked to the sponsor, total site costs and their basis, investigator fees in euros, other trial-personnel remuneration in euros and recruitment resources.
Figures come from the sponsor; consistent with the funding statement in the participant documents.

FI-P1.check: Uses the EU Compensation for Trial Participants template and states explicitly when no compensation is offered.

Expenses, loss of earnings, inconvenience payments and costs that could fall to the participant are stated; any exception to free protocol medicines, devices and procedures is explained and justified.
Amounts, conditions and recipients identical in every participant document; partial participation and early withdrawal are not financially punitive.
Minors receive no financial benefit or incentive; only direct costs and loss of earnings.

FI-P3.check: Describes every other relevant sponsor-site agreement; consistent with P1 and P2.

FI-FEE.check: Invoicing details in the CTIS Proof of payment section match Fimea's customer-data reporting form, including any purchase-order or project number required on the invoice.
No pre-submission payment evidence is presented as required.

FI-R1.check: EU statement on compliance with Union data-protection law completed in the CTIS Form section; no separate signature.
Sponsor details match the CTIS application; no national sentence added that the guides do not require.

FI-S1.check: Completed for every application; if no samples are collected or used, No is selected and the detailed sections are marked not applicable.
New and archive sample sections match the protocol and sample plan.
Analysis, storage, duration, access, coding and transfers match the participant documents.
Future-use section completed and consistent with the separate future-use information and consent (Tukija T/171/2025).
